reviewed_conclusions: All 108 fixed scope file hashes match; the ten own formal pages, four actual implementations and four mark bindings agree with the fixed inventory and association/UI receipts.
The four own conditional values .8/.7/.6/.5 replace the .9 fallback by whole-table selection; they are not a same-key stat_buffs override. Formatter output correctly reads as 20/30/40/50% reduction.

The movement formula applies only while the own item is wielded, the wrapper action-name condition is met, and action kind is native CHARGE_ACTIONS. At m_action=.50 and c=.50, m_charge=.75; this reduces the original penalty from 50% to 25%, not a direct 50% movement-speed bonus. Other speed factors remain independent; P4 action_shoot_charged is keyword-eligible but not a CHARGE_ACTIONS movement consumer.

The page separates conditional uninterruptible/stun_immune keywords from damage or all-control immunity, and distinguishes blessing gates from native action flags, caller/template immunity bypasses, ordinary attacks, melee/push specials and vent actions.

Equip installs the blessing; switching slots closes the held/action gate while retaining the source buff, and true unequip removes the installed buff. No hit proc, stack, timer or cooldown is claimed.

RAW name/description hashes, English/Traditional Chinese strings, I–IV formatter reconstruction and rules table match the receipts; omitted gates are classified as not covered rather than contradictory.

The 50%-original-penalty example is correctly evaluated: IV changes the movement multiplier .50→.75, a 25-point neutral-base change or 50% reduction of the original penalty, before independent modifiers.
Actual image 063 attachment and all four UI names/bindings match the scoped receipts and reverse associations.
